caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four slender, tapered legs, each leg featuring some carved detailing near the top. The tabletop is rectangular with a slightly undulating front edge and is colored in a medium brown hue, indicating a wood grain texture. Along the front edge of the table, there is decorative paneling; the central panel is oval-shaped and yellowish gold, flanked by two rectangular panels on either side with a similar yellowish gold coloration and leafy designs. The rest of the table's surface and legs are a consistent brown color, with some shadowing and highlights to suggest dimensionality. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background with a thin rectangular border, and there is a signature in the lower right corner.
title: Card Table
